title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 20: the penalties for serving Molech and other sins, and the call to be holy and set apart for Yahweh.

questions.text: Anyone who gave his offspring to which god was to be put to death?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says anyone who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death and be stoned by the people of the land.

answers.text: Baal
Chemosh
Molech
Dagon

questions.text: What would Yahweh do if the people of the land hid their eyes and did not put such a person to death?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would set his face against that man and against his family and cut them off from among their people.

answers.text: Set his face against that man and his family and cut them off
Send a plague on the whole land and its cattle
Hold back the rain from their fields for three years
Give their land and their houses to their enemies

questions.text: How does Yahweh describe himself in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 tells Israel to keep his statutes and ends with "I am Yahweh who sanctifies you."

answers.text: Yahweh who heals you
Yahweh who provides for you
Yahweh who fights for you
Yahweh who sanctifies you

questions.text: What penalty does verse 9 give for cursing one's father or mother?
questions.explanation: Everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; his blood shall be upon himself.

answers.text: He shall pay a fine in silver
He shall surely be put to death
He shall be put outside the camp for seven days
He shall bring a ram as a trespass offering

questions.text: According to verse 21, what will happen to a man who takes his brother's wife?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 calls it an impurity and says, "They shall be childless."

answers.text: They shall be burned with fire
They shall be stoned by the congregation
They shall be sent out of the land
They shall be childless

questions.text: If Israel kept all of Yahweh's statutes, what would the land not do to them?
questions.explanation: They were to keep his statutes and ordinances so that the land where he was bringing them would not vomit them out.

answers.text: Become barren
Be given to strangers
Vomit them out
Be covered with thorns

questions.text: How does Yahweh describe the land Israel would inherit?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would give them the land of the nations to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey.

answers.text: A land flowing with milk and honey
A land of wheat and barley
A land of olive trees and vines
A land of brooks and springs

questions.text: Between what were the Israelites to make a distinction, according to verse 25?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 tells them to distinguish between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean bird and the clean.

answers.text: Between holy bread and common bread
Between clean and unclean animals and birds
Between the first and the second harvest
Between linen and woolen garments

questions.text: For what purpose did Yahweh set Israel apart from the peoples?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had set them apart from the peoples, that they should be his.

answers.text: That they should rule over the nations
That they should build him a temple
That they should be his
That they should become a great army

questions.text: What was to happen to a man or woman who was a medium or a wizard?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says such a person shall surely be put to death; they shall be stoned with stones.

answers.text: They were to be stoned with stones
They were to be burned with fire
They were to be sent out of the land
They were to bring a guilt offering
